capabilities.text: Restrict access so only nurses on the same ward and their team leaders can view or edit notes
Encrypt all data at rest and in transit to comply with HIPAA and hospital data governance policies
Integrate with the Epic electronic patient record system to pull patient identifiers, names, MRN, and current bed number
Integrate with the ward’s daily handover spreadsheet in SharePoint to append final notes once a day
Allow nurses to enter structured fields for observations including blood pressure, heart rate, temperature, and pain score
Allow nurses to add medications using a dropdown formulary with dose, unit, and time given fields visible before saving
Flag new medications added by nurses for ward manager review the next day
Require nurses to log in with NHS smartcard and select their patient from a live list pulled from Epic at shift start
Block saving a note if required observations like pain score are missing, showing a clear error message
Show warnings for impossible or out-of-range observation values (e.g., heart rate above 200 bpm) but allow saving
Show warnings for medication doses outside normal ranges but allow saving with nurse confirmation
Log every note creation and edit with nurse ID, timestamp, and action type in a read-only audit log stored separately for seven years
Preserve full audit trail history including all versions of a note with timestamps and authorship
Allow ward managers and senior nurses to view completed notes and audit information without editing capability
Include medication flags in the ward manager’s review list to facilitate approval of new medications
Auto-populate patient bed number and MRN from Epic in the note entry form for nurse verification before saving
Auto-save notes in progress or prompt nurses to confirm before closing to prevent data loss and re-entry
Retain completed patient notes for at least seven years with automatic archiving to read-only format and block deletion before that
Support a pilot deployment on a ward with about 17 users, targeting three clean shifts with no double entry or major errors as acceptance criteria
Build the solution using Power Apps for the form, Power Automate for integrations, and a .NET service hosted in AWS behind a secure API gateway
